task: U87 - M102 relay-stack fixture TLS failure + U84b full-path confirmation

rootCause.summary: The M102/M103/M104 relay-stack suites were never registered in NODE_RUNTIME_INCLUDE, so the default `pnpm test` path (config/scripts/run-vitest.mjs -> bun --bun vitest) ran them in the |bun| project. Bun resolves `ws` to its built-in client, which fails the fixture's throwaway self-signed TLS handshake.
rootCause.mechanism: config/vitest.config.ts: when process.versions.bun is set, the node project includes only NODE_RUNTIME_INCLUDE and the bun project excludes those files. cloud-terminal-echo-latency / cloud-file-listing-latency / cloud-connection-establish-latency were absent from the list, so they landed in the bun pool.
rootCause.observedError: workspace ensure failed: OPEN_FAILED [object ErrorEvent] at cloud-relay-stack-fixture.ts:169 (ensureCloudWorkspace); uncaught ws error: WebSocket connection to 'wss://127.0.0.1:<port>/' failed: TLS handshake failed
rootCause.family: Same family as W5b defect B / W9A-7 audit MAJ-1 / U31 (real-TLS fixture must be in the node pool).
rootCause.not: Not a product defect, certificate/SAN problem, handshake-timeout problem, port-reuse problem, or concurrency race. The exact same fixture passes under the node pool.
rootCause.reproduction: bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config config/vitest.config.ts src/main/cloud-platform/cloud-terminal-echo-latency.test.ts (pre-fix: |bun| project, OPEN_FAILED TLS handshake, 2.5s)

fix.change: Register cloud-terminal-echo-latency.test.ts, cloud-file-listing-latency.test.ts and cloud-connection-establish-latency.test.ts in NODE_RUNTIME_INCLUDE with a Why comment; the default `pnpm test` path now routes them to the node-runtime pool.

verified.afterFixBunRunner: PASS via node config/scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config config/vitest.config.ts src/main/cloud-platform/cloud-terminal-echo-latency.test.ts (15.24s, 1/1)
verified.nodePoolSuites: cloud-file-listing-latency (M103) PASS; cloud-connection-establish-latency (M104) still FAIL for a separate, pre-existing reason (see knownSeparateIssue)
